status: local protocol frozen before the first batch; not a public preregistration

expected_patterns.learned_vs_erased_effects_quiet: positive paired success-rate difference if learned effect associations matter
expected_patterns.learned_vs_cached_value_need_shift: positive paired success-rate difference if current-state revaluation matters
expected_patterns.learned_blocked: observed failure followed by use of a previously experienced alternate route
expected_patterns.learned_vs_no_goal_buffer: no directional prediction; equality would weaken attribution of persistence to the active goal buffer
expected_patterns.paired_history: reversing prior outcome effects should change the first selected target at identical current observations
expected_patterns.satiated: stop if all learned outcome effects have nonpositive predicted regulation benefit after action cost

stop_rule: Run every configured seed and condition once. Do not tune settings to improve results. Fix implementation bugs only, record corrections and rerun the full affected batch.
claim_limit: Tests learned instrumental goal selection under a GIVEN regulation rule, not emergence of that rule, open-ended desire, subjectivity, personality, continuous life, language, or a neural model base.
